SELECT COALESCE(stage, 'start') AS stage,
       COALESCE(draft, '{}'::jsonb) AS draft,
       COALESCE(revision, 0) AS revision
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS sender_id) AS input
LEFT JOIN sessions USING (sender_id);

INSERT INTO sessions (sender_id, stage, draft, revision)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
ON CONFLICT (sender_id) DO UPDATE SET
  stage = EXCLUDED.stage,
  draft = EXCLUDED.draft,
  revision = EXCLUDED.revision,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING stage, draft, revision, $5::text AS response;

INSERT INTO sessions (sender_id, stage, draft, revision)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
ON CONFLICT (sender_id) DO UPDATE SET
  stage = EXCLUDED.stage,
  draft = EXCLUDED.draft,
  revision = EXCLUDED.revision,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING $1::text AS sender_id, stage, draft, revision, $5::text AS response;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resume_artifacts (
  artifact_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  sender_id text NOT NULL,
  file_name text NOT NULL,
  mime_type text NOT NULL,
  content_bytes bytea NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

INSERT INTO resume_artifacts (
  artifact_id, sender_id, file_name, mime_type, content_bytes
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, decode($5, 'base64'))
ON CONFLICT (artifact_id) DO UPDATE SET
  file_name = EXCLUDED.file_name,
  mime_type = EXCLUDED.mime_type,
  content_bytes = EXCLUDED.content_bytes,
  created_at = now()
RETURNING
  artifact_id,
  $6::text AS sender_id,
  $7::text AS stage,
  ($8::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('pdf_size_bytes', octet_length(content_bytes))) AS draft,
  $9::integer AS revision,
  $10::text AS reply,
  $10::text AS response,
  octet_length(content_bytes) AS pdf_size_bytes;

WITH artifact AS (
  SELECT
    artifact_id,
    file_name,
    mime_type,
    encode(content_bytes, 'base64') AS content_base64,
    octet_length(content_bytes) AS size_bytes
  FROM resume_artifacts
  WHERE artifact_id = $1
    AND sender_id = $2
)
SELECT
  $1::text AS requested_artifact_id,
  $2::text AS sender_id,
  artifact.artifact_id,
  artifact.file_name,
  artifact.mime_type,
  artifact.content_base64,
  artifact.size_bytes
FROM (SELECT 1) AS request
LEFT JOIN artifact ON TRUE;
